gloss: to the fullest, with all one's might

definitions.gloss: to the fullest, with all one's might, as hard as one can
definitions.explanation: Doing something with the maximum effort or capacity one has. Conveys a sense of giving everything one has, often with a nuance of earnestness or determination.

examples.japanese: {精一杯|せいいっぱい}⟦{頑張|がんば}ります→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: I will try my absolute best.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{精一杯|せいいっぱい}⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: The children ran with all their might.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{精一杯|せいいっぱい}⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: All I can do is give my absolute best at what I'm capable of right now.

notes:
USAGE:
{精一杯|せいいっぱい} can function as an adverb modifying a verb directly, or as a noun with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ ({精一杯|せいいっぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧). It often appears in declarations of determination or encouragement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精一杯|せいいっぱい}⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧: to try one's absolute best
- {精一杯|せいいっぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: the utmost effort
- {精一杯|せいいっぱい}⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧: to live life to the fullest
- {精一杯|せいいっぱい}⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧: to give it one's all

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧ also means "with all one's might" but emphasizes desperate, earnest effort. {精一杯|せいいっぱい} focuses more on reaching the limit of one's capacity or ability.
